gateway.description: WebSocket, TLS required outside localhost. Credentials only in Identify/Resume frames.

data.description: Missing installation grants are returned before close. Unknown or system capabilities use 4013; missing installation grants use 4014. Per-server snapshot and live ACL apply to every delivery.

shard.description: count in 1,2,4,8,16; 0<=id<count. Use recommendedShards; reshard overlaps replay from predecessor acknowledgements.

sequence.description: Signed PostgreSQL BIGINT encoded as decimal text; never convert to a JavaScript Number.
Signed PostgreSQL BIGINT encoded as decimal text; never convert to a JavaScript Number.

data.description: Bounded member snapshot, ten requests per application per minute. The members installation grant, current installation and matching shard are mandatory. Response event MEMBERS_CHUNK is not retained; request the page again after reconnect.

5 updates per application per 20 seconds; latest update among live sessions wins. Invisible publishes offline without activities. Offline after all leases expire plus 15 seconds grace; lastUsedAt is never presence.

sequence.description: Signed PostgreSQL BIGINT encoded as decimal text; never convert to a JavaScript Number.

data.description: Replace the durable websocket subscriptions selected by this session. Stored across resume. Every selected subscription must belong to this application and its event intents must be present in Identify. Server echoes this frame after commit.
ACK up to 100 owned, current leases atomically. Server echoes after commit. Old connection leases are fenced on resume; stale ACK closes with 4007 and the event is redelivered.

payload.description: Bounded JSON, maximum depth 20. Never include secrets.

data.description: Durable queue delivery, independent of ordinary Gateway cursor. ACK with opcode 13, deduplicate nested event.deliveryId, and do not overwrite the ordinary heartbeat/resume cursor with its historical sequence. Current shard, session intents and ACL are rechecked. Thirty-second lease; resume releases previous connection leases immediately.
